title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Spoon
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：drink　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drink 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1939 my grandmother ① made a drink that no patient in the house would have finished, and she said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② drink, meaning the cup and not the liquor, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a drink, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unfinished.

Every ③ drink in that house had the same short spoon at the side of it, and the ④ drink at the end, meaning the one they kept for the sick child and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A drink, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to finish; my grandmother said the finishing is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the drink was the whole of the story, meaning the liquor and not the cup. The ⑥ drink, meaning the liquor and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody offers and nobody admits; drink, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a cup and a liquor. He said the liquor is the part they remember.

By 1948 the ⑦ drink had become a line in a recipe, and the recipe had become an argument about the short spoon. The ⑧ drink of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one house and fourteen winters of finishing; drink, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to finish. She said the finishing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ drink I remember is the one named in the recipe, which cooled in 1960 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ drink, my mother said in 1962, is the only one that improves by being finished; every drink, she said, is a liquor that has agreed to look like a cup. She said the liquor was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 饮料；一份饮品（指那座房子里调过的那一份）
B. n. 饮料；一份饮品（指那杯饮品本身，与酒相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a drink 调一份饮品
D. n. 饮料；一份饮品（指留给病人的那一份）
E. n. 饮料；一份饮品（抽象总称，指一家人的饮水之事）
F. n. 饮料；一份饮品（指方子上写到、被列名的那一份）
G. n. 酒；饮酒（指故事里人人都劝却无人承认的那样东西）
H. n. 酒（抽象总称，指人人都劝却无人承认的那种东西）

items.q: made a drink that no patient in the house would have finished
The drink, meaning the cup and not the liquor
the drink was the whole of the story
the drink had become a line in a recipe
The drink of the whole thing
A drink, my mother said in 1962

answers.why: make a drink 意为“调一份饮品”，1939 年祖母调了一份屋子里没有一位病人肯喝完的饮品。
drink 意为“饮料、一份饮品”，指那杯饮品本身而不是酒，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
drink 意为“饮料、一份饮品”，指那座房子里的每一份饮品，每一份旁边都有同一把短短的勺子。
drink 意为“饮料、一份饮品”，指留给病人的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
drink 意为“酒、饮酒”，指故事里人人都劝却无人承认的那样东西，叔叔说这杯酒就是那个故事的全部。
drink 意为“酒”，指人人都劝却无人承认的那种东西而不是那杯饮品，是故事里人人都劝、却无人承认的东西。
drink 意为“饮料、一份饮品”，指方子上写到、被列名的那一份，到 1948 年这份饮品成了方子里的一行。
drink 意为“饮料、一份饮品”，祖母一月写道，整件事的饮水之事是一座房子和十四个冬天的喝完。
drink 意为“饮料、一份饮品”，我记得的是方子上列名的那一份，1960 年凉了，至今仍被说成屋子里最安静的一份。
drink 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，一份饮品是唯一会因为被好好喝完而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1939 年祖母调了一份屋子里没有一位病人肯喝完的饮品，她说调着才是那个冬天的全部。（make a drink）
那份饮品，指的是那杯饮品本身而不是酒，经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。（drink）
那座房子里每一份饮品旁边都有同一把短短的勺子。（drink）
末尾那一份饮品，指的是她们留给病人的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（drink）
叔叔说这杯酒就是那个故事的全部，指的是酒而不是那杯饮品。（drink）
1962 年母亲说，一份饮品是唯一会因为被好好喝完而变得更好的东西。（drink）
answers: In 1939 my grandmother made a drink that no patient in the house would have finished, and she said the making was the whole of the winter.
The drink, meaning the cup and not the liquor, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book.
Every drink in that house had the same short spoon at the side of it.
The drink at the end, meaning the one they kept for the sick child and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the drink was the whole of the story, meaning the liquor and not the cup.
A drink, my mother said in 1962, is the only one that improves by being finished.
